Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged, long-term investment accounts for U.S. citizen children under 18, launched via the 2025 "One Big Beautiful Bill". Launching July 4, 2026, they allow $5,000 in annual contributions, with a $1,000 government seed deposit for children born 2025–2028, managed by adults until age 18. Key Details for Trump Accounts (530A): Eligibility & Seed Money: All U.S. citizen children under 18 with a Social Security number are eligible. A $1,000 federal pilot contribution is available for children born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028. How to Open: Parents/guardians can sign up on TrumpAccounts.gov or by filing IRS Form 4547 with their 2025 tax return. TrumpAccounts.gov IRS Form 4547 Contributions: Parents, relatives, or employers can contribute up to $5,000 per child, per year (indexed for inflation in 2028). Tax Treatment: Earnings grow tax-deferred (similar to an IRA) until withdrawal, with the account owned by the child. Purpose: Designed for long-term growth, which can be used for future milestones like education or home purchases. As of April 2026, about 5 million children have been registered for the program.
